onboarding.subtitle: Personal dive intelligence
onboarding.disclaimer: DiveForge is a feedback tool. It does not replace your training, dive computer, or instructor. Thresholds are based on FFESSM/MN90 norms and must be verified by a professional.
onboarding.blePermission: DiveForge needs Bluetooth access to communicate with your dive computer.

sync.title: Sync
sync.permissionDenied: Bluetooth access denied. Check your device settings.
sync.connectionLost: Connection lost. Previously synced dives are saved.
sync.partialSuccess: {{synced}} of {{total}} dive(s) synced. Retry for the rest.

home.title: Home
home.noDives: No dives yet. Sync your dive computer to get started.

detail.title: Dive Detail
detail.disclaimer: DiveForge is a feedback tool, not a medical device.

trends.title: Trends
trends.noData: Not enough data. Sync your dives.

ascent_too_fast.title: Fast ascent
ascent_too_fast.body: You ascended at {{maxRateMpm}} m/min between {{startSec}}s and {{endSec}}s. MN90 norm: 15 m/min.

ascent_dangerous.title: Dangerous ascent
ascent_dangerous.body: Ascent rate of {{maxRateMpm}} m/min sustained over 60s. Risk of decompression sickness.

final_ascent_too_fast.title: Fast final ascent
final_ascent_too_fast.body: Ascent from 6m to surface at {{rateMpm}} m/min. Recommended: under 6 m/min in this zone.

palier_securite_manque.title: Safety stop missing
palier_securite_manque.body: Max depth {{maxDepthM}} m with no safety stop (3-5m for 3 min). Recommended for any dive beyond 6m.

palier_securite_court.title: Short safety stop
palier_securite_court.body: Safety stop of {{actualSec}}s instead of the recommended 180s.

palier_deco_manque.title: Missed deco stop
palier_deco_manque.body: Required deco stop at {{decoDepthM}} m for {{decoTimeSec}}s was not completed. Immediate DCS risk.

profondeur_depasse_niveau_leger.title: Slightly exceeded depth limit
profondeur_depasse_niveau_leger.body: Max depth {{maxDepthM}} m. Limit for your level ({{niveau}}): {{limitM}} m.

profondeur_depasse_niveau_grave.title: Severely exceeded depth limit
profondeur_depasse_niveau_grave.body: Max depth {{maxDepthM}} m, exceeding your level ({{niveau}}) limit by {{excessM}} m.

temperature_basse.title: Cold water
temperature_basse.body: Min temperature {{minTempC}} C over {{durationMin}} min. Cold increases air consumption and narcosis risk.

plongee_profonde.title: Deep dive
plongee_profonde.body: Maximum depth reached: {{maxDepthM}} m. Informational only.

summaryTips.improving_ascent_control: Your ascent rates are improving. Keep monitoring your computer at end of dive.
summaryTips.consistent_safety_stops: Your safety stops are consistent. Excellent safety habit.
summaryTips.depth_management_improving: Your depth management is improving. Stay mindful of your level limits.
summaryTips.overall_good: Your dives follow good practices. Keep it up!
summaryTips.needs_attention: Several recent alerts. Review the flagged dives and consult your instructor if needed.
